lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Six high-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso, showing approximately equidistant spacing across the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line is a truncated segment that terminates approximately 40% down from the dorsal ridge; the most anterior line is partially obscured by neck shadows.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct white spots are visible on the posterior haunch, positioned vertically relative to one another on the upper hind limb area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: S-shaped lyrate curvature; horns emerge laterally at approximately 45 degrees from the skull base before curving medially and upward towards the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.5 times the width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The light-colored ivory tipping comprises approximately 12-15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white V-shaped chevron between the eyes; distinctive orange-tan coloration on all four lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints; a long dark hair fringe along the ventral neck and chest.
